subject: Follow-up: Embeddings fit & validation for Alegra Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@alegrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Embeddings fit & validation for Alegra Health

Hi Sara — great to meet you and the Eng team today. Quick recap from our discovery + recommended next steps so we keep momentum.

Call highlights:
- Primary use case: semantic search across clinical notes + product docs (support queries + triage).
- Current infra: PostgreSQL + ElasticSearch for metadata; want higher recall on short queries (~2-5 words) and better semantic similarity for paraphrases.
- Privacy: PHI-sensitive pipeline; will require Private deployment or dedicated tenancy (we discussed Dedicated).

Early recommendations (model fit & validation):
- Candidate embeddings: Redwood-Embed-2 (1536d) as the default tradeoff for recall vs cost; OpenEmbed-3 (2048d) if maximizing semantic recall for long-form clinical text.
- Metrics to validate: recall@10, MRR, mean cosine similarity gap (pos vs neg), and clustering purity for categorical labels (department/condition).
- Drift checks: sample weekly cosine distributions, monitor mean/variance per cohort; we recommend a simple KL-divergence alert if distribution shifts > 0.08 relative to baseline.

Attachments I’m sending with this note: alegra_sample_queries.csv (1k sample queries), embedding_benchmark_summary.pdf (initial bench on public health dataset).

Next steps I propose:
1) You send ~1k labeled positive/negative pairs (or let us use the attached sample set) — we’ll run a short-fit validation with both candidate models and return precision/recall + suggested dimensionality/quantization.
2) We’ll provide a sandbox project and a Drive link with reproducible benchmark code and prompt sets.
3) Quick 30-min follow-up next week to walk results and agree on POC scope.

If that sounds good, I’ll schedule the sandbox and run the initial eval as soon as we have the sample pairs.

Thanks —
Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: alegra_sample_queries.csv (csv)
Attachment: embedding_benchmark_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@alegrahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alegra Health Eng <eng@alegrahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Embeddings fit & validation for Alegra Health

Hi Marcus — thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A couple quick clarifications and next-step asks: 

- We can share 1k labeled pairs but need to scrub direct PHI (we’ll provide pseudo-anonymized text). Is that sufficient for the validation work?
- For Dedicated vs Private: security is a hard requirement for production, but for the POC we’re happy to use a sandbox on your hosted environment if data is pseudo-anonymized.
- Could you provide the lightweight benchmark script (so our SRE can run a dry run internally)?

We’re targeting an internal stakeholder demo the week of Mar 9 — if we can have initial results by Mar 5 that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sara
VP Product
Alegra Health

P.S. I’ve uploaded a short sample set to the shared bucket — I’ll share the link after we confirm the scrub approach.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Embeddings fit & validation for Alegra Health

On Wed, 25 Feb 2026 at 09:12, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Call highlights:
> - Primary use case: semantic search across clinical notes + product docs...

Agree with Marcus’ plan. A few internal notes for the eval pipeline and what we should surface in the POC report: 

- Model candidates: prioritize Redwood-Embed-2 (1536d) as the cost/latency sweet spot. Run OpenEmbed-3 (2048d) as a higher-accuracy baseline. If Sara’s team is sensitive to vector size for storage, include a 768d run (Redwood-Embed-Small) to show cost/recall tradeoffs.
- Quantization: include 8-bit and 4-bit quantized results (we’ve seen ~1–2% drop in recall for 8-bit on clinical text, but 4-bit can be more variable). Report wall-clock index/search latencies for standard Annoy/HNSW setups.
- Evaluation artifacts to deliver: precision@k, recall@k, MRR, AUC (if we have binary labels), cosine similarity histograms, and a drift baseline. Include a simple notebook that reproduces the plots.

I’ll prepare the benchmark script and prompt sets, and I can also seed the Drive folder with an example notebook and instructions. Marcus — do you want me to draft the POC runbook or should we keep it light for the first pass?

—Marissa
Senior ML Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Johnson <sara.johnson@alegrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Embeddings fit & validation for Alegra Health

Sara — thanks, and great to see alignment. Quick consolidated next steps and links so your team has everything in one place: 

1) Data: please upload the pseudo-anonymized 1k labeled pairs to the Drive folder (link below). If you prefer, we can also accept a secure S3 presigned URL.
2) Benchmarks & artifacts: we’ve seeded a Drive folder with the benchmark script, prompt sets, and an example notebook (see links). I’ve attached embedding_prompt_sets.json with the canonical prompts we’ll use for seeding anchors and negative sampling.
3) POC sandbox: I created a sandbox invite for one project (alegra-poc) — instructions in alegra_poc_sandbox_invite.txt. The sandbox runs Redwood-Embed-2 and OpenEmbed-3 by default and will produce the metrics report.

Links and assets:
- Benchmark Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-alegra-embeddings
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721
- Public benchmark snapshot: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/embeddings/2026-q1

Ask: can you confirm upload by Mar 3 EOD PST so we can deliver initial results by Mar 5? If you want, I can schedule the 30-min results review on Mar 6 or Mar 9 — I’ll hold a few slots.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the validation run started.

Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: embedding_prompt_sets.json (json)
Attachment: alegra_poc_sandbox_invite.txt (txt)
